articles.title_en: Dynamic programming in economics on a quantum annealer
articles.title_cn: 经济学中的动态规划在量子退火机上的应用
articles.abstract_en: We introduce novel algorithms for solving dynamic programming problems in economics on a quantum annealer, a specialized quantum computer used for combinatorial optimization. Quantum annealers begin in a superposition of all states and generate candidate global solutions in milliseconds, regardless of problem size. In contrast to existing methods, those developed in this paper (1) recover value and policy functions, (2) avoid fundamental scaling bottlenecks, and (3) are already implementable for small (but non‐trivial) problems on current hardware. We demonstrate the method by solving the real business cycle model on a quantum annealer.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们介绍了在量子退火机上解决经济学中动态规划问题的新算法，量子退火机是一种专门用于组合优化的量子计算机。量子退火机从所有状态的叠加态开始，无论问题规模大小，都能在毫秒内生成候选全局解。与现有方法相比，本文开发的方法（1）能够恢复价值函数和政策函数，（2）避免了根本性的规模瓶颈，并且（3）已经可以在当前硬件上实现小规模（但非平凡）的问题。我们通过求解真实商业周期模型在量子退火机上的实例来演示该方法。

articles.title_en: Durables and lemons: Private information and the market for cars
articles.title_cn: 耐用品与柠檬：私人信息与汽车市场
articles.abstract_en: Private information on car quality means the sale price reflects the average quality of cars sold, which can be lower than the average quality in the population. This difference is the lemons penalty imposed on holders of high‐quality cars. We estimate the evolution of the lemons penalty through an equilibrium model of car ownership with private information using Danish linked registry data on car ownership, income, and wealth. We examine the aggregate implications and distributional consequences of these penalties. In the first year of ownership, we estimate that the lemons penalty is 12% of the price. The penalty declines sharply with the length of ownership. It reduces the self‐insurance value of cars and leads to a large reduction in transaction volumes and the rate of car turnover. The market does not collapse: income shocks induce households to sell their cars, even if they are of good quality, and this helps mitigate the lemons problem. The size of the lemons penalty declines when income uncertainty in the economy increases and when the supply of credit decreases.
articles.abstract_cn: 关于汽车质量的私人信息意味着销售价格反映了所售汽车的平均质量，这可能低于总体中的平均质量。这一差异是对高质量汽车持有者施加的柠檬惩罚。我们利用丹麦关于汽车所有权、收入和财富的关联登记数据，通过一个具有私人信息的汽车所有权均衡模型来估计柠檬惩罚的演变。我们考察了这些惩罚的总体影响和分配后果。在拥有汽车的第一年，我们估计柠檬惩罚为价格的12%。惩罚随着拥有时间的延长而急剧下降。它降低了汽车的自我保险价值，并导致交易量和汽车周转率大幅下降。市场并未崩溃：收入冲击促使家庭出售他们的汽车，即使这些汽车质量良好，这有助于缓解柠檬问题。当经济中的收入不确定性增加且信贷供应减少时，柠檬惩罚的规模会下降。

articles.title_en: Effects of disruptive peers in endogenous social networks
articles.title_cn: 内生社交网络中破坏性同伴的影响
articles.abstract_en: This study uses sociometric data to show that social connections in the classroom shape the diffusion of the negative externalities on cognitive achievement generated by abused and neglected peers. We find the strongest negative effects for students who are socially closest to the abused and neglected peer. The fade‐out rate of the negative externality is such that being three peers away from an abused and neglected peer is equivalent to having no such peers. Although the inverse effect‐distance relation applies to both verbal and numeric ability, it is conferred through different mechanisms. The abused and neglected peer's lower verbal ability harms her friends' verbal ability, whereas it is the disruptiveness itself that harms classmates' numeric ability.
articles.abstract_cn: 本研究利用社会计量数据表明，课堂中的社会联系塑造了受虐待和被忽视同伴对认知成就产生的负面外部性的扩散。我们发现，与受虐待和被忽视同伴社会距离最近的学生受到最强烈的负面影响。负面外部性的衰减率使得，与受虐待和被忽视同伴相隔三个同伴距离等同于没有此类同伴。尽管这种反向效应-距离关系同时适用于语言能力和数字能力，但其作用机制不同。受虐待和被忽视同伴较低的语言能力损害了其朋友的语言能力，而破坏性本身则损害了同学的数字能力。

articles.title_en: Skill formation and the trouble with child noncognitive skill measures
articles.title_cn: 技能形成与儿童非认知技能测量中的问题
articles.abstract_en: This paper develops a framework to address issues of contamination in parent‐reported measures of child noncognitive skills. We estimate a dynamic model in which child and parental skills evolve jointly and leverage information provided by teachers and interviewers to deal with contamination of parent‐reported measures. The model also allows us to examine the relative importance of mothers and fathers in the evolution of child skills. Our findings reveal that ignoring contamination significantly underestimates the role of maternal non‐cognitive skills in the evolution of child noncognitive skills. Additionally, we find evidence of stronger feedback effects from child skills to mothers than fathers. Simulation exercises demonstrate how contamination can distort evaluations of early childhood policies, underscoring the importance of robust measurement approaches.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文开发了一个框架来解决家长报告的儿童非认知技能测量中的污染问题。我们估计了一个动态模型，其中儿童和父母的技能共同演化，并利用教师和访谈者提供的信息来处理家长报告测量中的污染。该模型还使我们能够考察母亲和父亲在儿童技能演化中的相对重要性。我们的发现表明，忽视污染会显著低估母亲非认知技能在儿童非认知技能演化中的作用。此外，我们发现有证据表明，儿童技能对母亲的反馈效应强于对父亲的。模拟实验表明，污染如何扭曲对早期儿童政策的评估，强调了稳健测量方法的重要性。

articles.title_en: The local approach to causal inference under network interference
articles.title_cn: 网络干扰下的局部因果推理方法
articles.abstract_en: We propose a new nonparametric modeling framework for causal inference when outcomes depend on how agents are linked in a social or economic network. Such network interference describes a large literature on treatment spillovers, social interactions, social learning, information diffusion, disease and financial contagion, social capital formation, and more. Our approach works by first characterizing how an agent is linked in the network using the configuration of other agents and connections nearby as measured by path distance. The impact of a policy or treatment assignment is then learned by pooling outcome data across similarly configured agents. We demonstrate the approach by deriving finite‐sample bounds on the mean‐squared error of a k‐nearest neighbor estimator for the average treatment response as well as proposing an asymptotically valid test for the hypothesis of policy irrelevance. We illustrate the empirical applicability of our method with simulations and an application to social capital formation.
articles.abstract_cn: 当结果取决于主体在社会或经济网络中的链接方式时，我们提出了一种新的用于因果推理的非参数建模框架。这种网络干扰描述了大量关于治疗溢出、社会互动、社会学习、信息传播、疾病和金融传染、社会资本形成等方面的文献。我们的方法首先通过使用其他代理的配置和通过路径距离测量的附近连接来描述代理在网络中的链接方式。然后，通过汇集类似配置的代理的结果数据来了解策略或治疗分配的影响。我们通过推导平均治疗响应的 k 最近邻估计量的均方误差的有限样本界限来演示该方法，并提出对政策无关假设的渐近有效检验。我们通过模拟和对社会资本形成的应用来说明我们的方法的经验适用性。

articles.title_en: Technical change, wage inequality, and optimal taxes in an assignment model
articles.title_cn: 技术变革、工资不平等与分配模型中的最优税收
articles.abstract_en: This paper studies income inequality and optimal taxation policies in a talent‐to‐task assignment model of self‐selection. Our model considers relative capital‐skill complementarities across tasks, leading to the polarization of capital and technology by task complexity, which in turn drives the polarization of job and wage growth by talent levels. Regarding optimal tax policy, the wage compression channel remains effective through the trickle‐down effect of subsidizing high‐wage earners and taxing low‐wage earners. Yet, the wage compression channel via capital, corporate, and R&D taxes, aimed at reducing wage inequality, does not operate via a trickle‐down effect. Instead, it works by taxing capital income and R&D investments in high‐task‐complexity sectors while subsidizing those in low‐task‐complex sectors. Moreover, we identify a Pigouvian effect that arises to address spillovers, which modifies the marginal tax rates on labor income, capital income, firm profits, and R&D investments.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文在自我选择的人才-任务分配模型中研究收入不平等与最优税收政策。我们的模型考虑了任务间相对资本-技能互补性，导致资本和技术按任务复杂度极化，进而推动就业和工资增长按人才水平极化。关于最优税收政策，工资压缩渠道通过补贴高收入者和对低收入者征税的涓滴效应仍然有效。然而，旨在减少工资不平等的通过资本、公司税和研发税实现的工资压缩渠道并非通过涓滴效应运作。相反，它通过对高任务复杂度部门的资本收入和研发投资征税，同时补贴低任务复杂度部门来实现。此外，我们识别出一种庇古效应，该效应旨在解决溢出问题，并调整劳动收入、资本收入、企业利润和研发投资的边际税率。

articles.title_en: Identification and estimation of continuous‐time dynamic discrete choice games
articles.title_cn: 连续时间动态离散选择博弈的识别与估计
articles.abstract_en: This paper considers the theoretical, computational, and econometric properties of continuous‐time dynamic discrete choice games with stochastically sequential moves, introduced by Arcidiacono, Bayer, Blevins, and Ellickson (2016). We consider identification of the rate of move arrivals, which was assumed to be known in previous work, as well as a generalized version with heterogeneous move arrival rates. We reestablish conditions for existence of a Markov perfect equilibrium in the generalized model and consider identification of the model primitives with only discrete‐time data sampled at fixed intervals. Three foundational example models are considered: a single agent renewal model, a dynamic entry and exit model, and a quality ladder model. Through these examples we examine the computational and statistical properties of estimators via Monte Carlo experiments and an empirical example using data from Rust (1987). The experiments show how parameter estimates behave when moving from continuous‐time data to discrete‐time data of decreasing frequency and the computational feasibility as the number of firms grows. The empirical example highlights the impact of allowing decision rates to vary.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文考虑了由Arcidiacono, Bayer, Blevins和Ellickson (2016)引入的具有随机序贯移动的连续时间动态离散选择博弈的理论、计算和计量经济学性质。我们考虑了移动到达率的识别，这在先前的工作中被假定为已知，以及具有异质移动到达率的广义版本。我们在广义模型中重新确立了马尔可夫完美均衡存在的条件，并考虑了仅以固定间隔采样的离散时间数据下模型原始参数的识别问题。考虑了三个基础示例模型：单一主体更新模型、动态进入退出模型和质量阶梯模型。通过这些示例，我们通过蒙特卡洛实验和使用Rust (1987)数据的实证示例检验了估计量的计算和统计性质。实验展示了当从连续时间数据转向频率递减的离散时间数据时参数估计的行为，以及随着企业数量增长的计算可行性。实证示例突出了允许决策率变化的影响。
